# `part` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/part.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

An embedded library copy (doc 07 §2.1, doc 05 §13.2): `$k`, `id` (the copy ID
`v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`), `$v`, the copy metadata, then the item's own members.

`sha256` is taken over the canonical compact JSON of the item's own members, without `id` and the copy
metadata, so the copy's hash equals the published item's (EW-CORE-014).

Deserialisation reads the copy metadata itself and hands the remaining members to the item's own
deserialiser, so errors inside the item keep their paths (a flattened field would lose them).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `part` |
| File | `lib/parts/<id>.json` |
| Rank | null |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`part.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/part.schema.json) |

### CpData

One CP of a part's pattern (doc 07 §2.5, L1), with the clamp data of FR-PRT-008 (clamp type, cross-section
range, maximum conductors, twin-ferrule permission). The load current (1.0) is kept in `extra` until its
work package.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clamp` | [`ClampKey`](#clampkey) or `null` | no |  | Terminal clamp. |
| `clamp_type` | [`ClampType`](#clamptype) or `null` | no |  | The kind of clamp (FR-PRT-008). |
| `csa_max` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) or `null` | no |  | The largest conductor cross-section the clamp takes, in mm². |
| `csa_min` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) or `null` | no |  | The smallest conductor cross-section the clamp takes, in mm². |
| `designation` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | Designation. |
| `idx` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | Index. |
| `level` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) or `null` | no |  | Terminal level. |
| `max_conductors` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) or `null` | no |  | The most conductors the clamp takes. |
| `potential_role` | [`PotentialType`](#potentialtype) or `null` | no |  | Potential role. |
| `side` | [`Side`](#side) or `null` | no |  | Terminal side. |
| `twin_ferrule` | boolean | no |  | The clamp takes a twin ferrule. |

### ClampKey

The clamp of a terminal CP (doc 08 §2.3): `{"clamp": "a"}`, `{"shaft": 1}` or `"rail_foot"`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A wire clamp a, b, c ….

   Shape: object { `clamp`: string (at least 1 character(s), at most 1 character(s)) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `clamp` | string (at least 1 character(s), at most 1 character(s)) | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A bridge shaft.

   Shape: object { `shaft`: integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `shaft` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**: The rail foot of a PE terminal.

   Shape: `"rail_foot"`

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

An authored date YYYY-MM-DD (doc 05 §3.2).

Pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`

### ItemStatus

Status of a library item.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Draft.

   Shape: `"draft"`

2. **Form 2**: Released (the default).

   Shape: `"released"`

3. **Form 3**: Deprecated, with an optional successor: `{"deprecated": {"successor": …}}`.

   Shape: object { `deprecated`: [`Deprecation`](#deprecation) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `deprecated` | [`Deprecation`](#deprecation) | yes |  | The payload of `ItemStatus::Deprecated`. |

4. **Form 4**: Withdrawn.

   Shape: `"withdrawn"`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### PartSections

Domain sections of a part (FR-PRT-010). Typed: the cable cores, the PLC section and the carrier sections of
FR-PRT-024 (enclosure, duct, rail, mounting plate); the other sections stay in `extra`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | [`BusSection`](#bussection) or `null` | no |  | The bus section: the part's bus interfaces (doc 10 §2.6, WP-S1.21 D15). |
| `cable_cores` | array of [`CableCore`](#cablecore) | no |  | Cores of a cable part, from which conductors are generated (FR-CBL-004). |
| `duct` | [`DuctSection`](#ductsection) or `null` | no |  | The duct section: inner dimensions and slot pitch. |
| `enclosure` | [`EnclosureSection`](#enclosuresection) or `null` | no |  | The enclosure section: outer and wall dimensions and the mounting plate (doc 12 §2.5). |
| `mounting_plate` | [`PlateSection`](#platesection) or `null` | no |  | The mounting-plate section: its dimensions. |
| `plc` | [`PlcSection`](#plcsection) or `null` | no |  | The PLC section (doc 10 §2.6). |
| `rail` | [`RailSection`](#railsection) or `null` | no |  | The rail section: profile and stock length. |

### BusSection

The bus section of a part (`sections.bus`, doc 10 §2.6; WP-S1.21 D15): the part's bus interfaces. A part port
is carried by a function of the device whose function definition has contact kind `bus_port`; normaliser N5
gives a port-less such function the part's port once and never rewrites it (D16). The station address and the
nets belong to the drawn port (`BusPort`), not to the part.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ports` | array of [`PartBusPort`](#partbusport) | no |  | The part's bus interfaces, in the part's order. The schema enforces no uniqueness: every reader takes the first port of an (`interface`, `port_label`) pair and ignores later ones. |

### PartBusPort

One bus interface of a part (WP-S1.21 D15): the first four members as in `BusPort`. No address, net,
connector, signal map or address range is typed; those stay in `extra` (1.0).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | [`BusSystem`](#bussystem) | yes |  | The bus system. |
| `interface` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The interface name ("DP", "X1"). |
| `port_label` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The port label of a multi-port interface ("P1R"). |
| `role` | [`PortRole`](#portrole) | yes |  | The role a port made from this interface takes. |
| `termination` | [`OnOff`](#onoff) or `null` | no |  | Present: the interface has a termination switch, in this state; absent: it has none. |

### PlcSection

The PLC section of a part (doc 10 §2.6, level L2 part data). The earth, bus ports and the `meta` confidence are
additive and stay in `extra` until their work packages.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bit_of` | [`MapSpec`](#mapspec) or `null` | no |  | The channel map: channel number → bit offset in the module's range (doc 10 §2.6, "n", "16n" or a list); absent: linear. |
| `channels` | [`ChannelSpec`](#channelspec) or `null` | no |  | The channels a module instantiates. |
| `io` | array of [`IoRange`](#iorange) | no |  | The I/O ranges the part occupies. |
| `pin_of` | [`PinMap`](#pinmap) or `null` | no |  | The channel → pin map of a module with physical pins (doc 10 §3.3, normaliser N3): channel number → the designation of the module's connection point ("X2:{n+1}", or a list); absent: the channels have no pins (internal channels, such as the solenoid outputs of a valve-terminal module). |
| `positions` | [`PositionMap`](#positionmap) or `null` | no |  | The solenoid-position map of a valve-terminal module (doc 10 §2.6 `[plc.positions]`, §3.2 step 4, §3.3 normaliser N2); absent: the module serves no valve positions. |
| `role` | [`PlcRole`](#plcrole) | yes |  | What the part is in the PLC model. |
| `supply_groups` | array of [`SupplyGroup`](#supplygroup) | no |  | The supply groups of the part's power-supply pins (doc 10 §2.6, FR-PLC-024, WP-S1.21 D13): each names the L+ and M pins of one group, so that the pins take the potential roles `L+` and `M` when neither the part pattern nor the function definition gives them one (`ew_derive::FunctionCps`). Appended after `pin_of`, so a part without groups writes the bytes it wrote before (the member order fixes a copy's hash). |
| `unbound` | [`ChannelState`](#channelstate) or `null` | no |  | The state of channels neither bound nor claimed (doc 10 §3.2); absent: spare. |

### ChannelSpec

The channels a module part instantiates.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | How many (numbers 0 … count − 1). |
| `data_type` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The data type in the profile vocabulary ("Bool"). |
| `designation` | string or `null` | no |  | The automatic designation pattern over `{n}` ("{n}", "DO {n}"). |
| `kind` | [`ChannelKind`](#channelkind) | yes |  | Their kind. |

### ChannelKind

The kind of a channel (doc 10 §2.4). `multi_function` (IO-Link port modes, 1.0) is additive.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"di"` | Digital input. |
| `"do"` | Digital output. |
| `"ai"` | Analogue input. |
| `"ao"` | Analogue output. |
| `"counter"` | Counter. |
| `"io_link_port"` | IO-Link port. |
| `"power_supply"` | Power supply. |

### ChannelState

An explicit channel state (doc 10 §3.2); `used` is never stored, it is derived from the target.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"spare"` | Spare. |
| `"reserved"` | Reserved. |
| `"deactivated"` | Deactivated. |

### IoRange

One I/O range of a part.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bits` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The width in bits. |
| `class` | [`IoClass`](#ioclass) | no |  | The address class; default digital. |
| `dir` | [`IoDir`](#iodir) | yes |  | The direction. |

### IoClass

The address class of an I/O range (the profile keeps one allocation cursor per class).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"digital"` | Digital (the default). |
| `"analog"` | Analogue. |

### IoDir

The direction of an I/O range.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"in"` | Inputs. |
| `"out"` | Outputs. |

### MapSpec

A part-data map (doc 10 §2.6): an expression "&lt;k>n[+&lt;c>]" or "&lt;k>p[+&lt;c>]", or an explicit list.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: array of integer (min 0, max 4294967295)

### PinMap

A channel → pin map (doc 10 §3.3): a designation pattern with `{<expression in n>}` placeholders ("X2:{n+1}"), or an explicit list of pin designations.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: array of string (at least 1 character(s))

### PlcRole

The PLC role of a part.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"station"` | A station (CPU, head, bus node). |
| `"module"` | An I/O module. |

### PortRole

The role of a bus port (doc 10 §2.7).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"master"` | A bus master (PROFIBUS DP master). |
| `"slave"` | A slave. |
| `"controller"` | A controller (PROFINET IO controller). |
| `"device"` | A device (PROFINET IO device). |
| `"passive"` | A passive element without an address: a bus connector. |

### PositionMap

The solenoid-position map of a valve-terminal module part (doc 10 §2.6 `[plc.positions]`): the channel
that each solenoid of the valve at position index `p` drives. The position index is 0-based: the valve
child at `Device.position` = q sits at p = q − 1 (doc 11 §3.2). Part 533361 of Golden A carries the test
input H1, `count = 4`, solenoid 14 → `2p`, solenoid 12 → `2p+1` (doc 20 §11.2).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The number of valve positions (p = 0 … count − 1). |
| `map` | array of [`SolenoidChannel`](#solenoidchannel) | no |  | One entry per solenoid name, in part-data order. |

Potential types (doc 03 §9.1, FR-CON-010).

| Value | Meaning |

| `"l1"` | Phase L1. |
| `"l2"` | Phase L2. |
| `"l3"` | Phase L3. |
| `"l"` | Single-phase line. |
| `"n"` | Neutral. |
| `"pe"` | Protective earth. |
| `"pen"` | Combined PE and N. |
| `"fe"` | Functional earth. |
| `"l_plus"` | DC positive. |
| `"l_minus"` | DC negative. |
| `"m"` | DC mid or 0 V. |
| `"signal"` | Signal. |
| `"undefined"` | Undefined. |

### Pt2

A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

The rail section of a part (FR-PRT-024, doc 12 §2.5).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `profile` | [`MountKind`](#mountkind) | yes |  | The rail profile. |
| `stock_length` | [`Nm`](#nm) or `null` | no |  | The stock length in nanometres. |

Representation types (doc 03 §6, doc 07 §2.3). `panel_front` is a symbol type only: panel-front
representations are derived, never stored (ADR-0006 amendment 3).

| Value | Meaning |

| `"multi_line"` | Multi-line (the default). |
| `"single_line"` | Single-line. |
| `"overview"` | Overview. |
| `"fluid"` | Fluid. |
| `"topology"` | Bus topology. |
| `"contact_image"` | Contact image. |

| `"strip_segment"` | Strip segment. |
| `"graphic"` | Graphic. |

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

### Side

A terminal side (doc 08 §2.1: side 1 is internal and side 2 external unless `Strip.field_side` says
otherwise).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"side1"` | Side 1. |
| `"side2"` | Side 2. |

### SolenoidChannel

One entry of a `PositionMap`: the channel of one solenoid as a function of the position index.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | [`MapSpec`](#mapspec) | yes |  | The channel number at position index p: a `p` expression ("2p", "2p+1") or a list indexed by p. |
| `solenoid` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The solenoid ("14", "12"), matched against the designation of the valve's coil CP. |

### SupplyGroup

One supply group of a PLC part (doc 10 §2.6 `[[plc.supply]]`, FR-PLC-024, WP-S1.21 D13): the L+ and M pins that
feed the electronics or a load group, and the channels the group feeds. The earth pin (`[plc.earth]`) is not part
of a group and stays in `PlcSection::extra`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cps` | [`SupplyPins`](#supplypins) | yes |  | The group's L+ and M pins. |
| `feeds` | [`SupplyFeeds`](#supplyfeeds) or `null` | no |  | The channels the group feeds; absent: all of them (`SupplyGroup::feeds`). Read by no rule at the MVP (EW-PLC-014 is 1.0). |
| `kind` | [`SupplyKind`](#supplykind) | yes |  | What the group supplies. |

### SupplyFeeds

The channels a supply group feeds.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"all"` | Every channel of the module (the default). |
| `"inputs"` | The input channels. |
| `"outputs"` | The output channels. |

### SupplyKind

What a supply group supplies (FR-PLC-024).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"electronics"` | The module's electronics. |
| `"load"` | A load group (the outputs' load voltage). |

### SupplyPins

The L+ and M pins of a supply group, by the designation of the part's connection point ("4", "X1:2").

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `l_plus` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The pin that takes the potential role `L+`. |
| `m` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The pin that takes the potential role `M`. |

### TechValue

One technical value (doc 05 §3.2 `TechValue`): `{"key", "value"}` whose value is a `Quantity` or an
`Ident`, told apart by JSON type.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The property key, such as `i_out` or `curve`. |
| `value` | [`TechVal`](#techval) | yes |  | The value. |

### TechVal

The value of a `TechValue`, told apart by JSON type: an object is a `Quantity`, a string an
`Ident`. Any other JSON type is kept as `TechVal::Unknown`; an object that is not a quantity or a
string that is not an identifier is a malformed variant (`quantity`, `ident`).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A quantity such as 20 A.

   Shape: [`Quantity`](#quantity)

2. **Form 2**: An identifier such as the tripping curve `C`.

   Shape: [`Ident`](#ident)

### Quantity

A decimal value with its unit (doc 03 §3.2): `{"value": Dec3, "unit": Unit}`. Rendering ("0.75 mm²",
decimal comma in nl and de) is a query, never stored text (D-18).

```
use ew_schema::{Quantity, Unit};

let q: Quantity = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"value":"20","unit":"A"}"#).unwrap();
assert_eq!(q.unit, Unit::A);
assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&q).unwrap(), r#"{"value":"20","unit":"A"}"#);
```

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | [`Unit`](#unit) | yes |  | Its unit. |
| `value` | [`Dec3`](#dec3) | yes |  | The number. |

### TemplateFn

One function of a part's template (FR-PRT-007).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cps` | array of integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | no |  | Indices into `cp_pattern`. |
| `fndef` | [`LibRef`](#libref) | yes |  | The function definition. |
| `main` | boolean | no |  | The main function of the part. |

### Unit

The units of doc 03 §3.2 and the order units of FR-PRT-026. Persisted as the unit symbol in ASCII
(`"mm2"`, `"degC"`), so files stay greppable; rendering uses the typographic symbol.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"mm2"` | Square millimetre (cross-sections). |
| `"A"` | Ampere. |
| `"V"` | Volt. |
| `"Hz"` | Hertz. |
| `"bar"` | Bar (pressure). |
| `"degC"` | Degree Celsius. |
| `"kg"` | Kilogram. |
| `"W"` | Watt. |
| `"m"` | Metre (lengths and the order unit of cables). |
| `"piece"` | Piece (the default order unit). |
| `"set"` | Set (order unit). |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### Vec2Nm

An offset [dx, dy] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2): a vector, not a position.

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))
